verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Terminal supports an API-based integration alongside its client SDKs for building a custom POS, and that the server-driven integration includes a simulated reader for testing. Reader registration and locations can be managed through the API. A community developer also praises being able to integrate with the API at the terminal level. missing for 10: documentation of the specific server-driven reader actions (e.g., sending a payment to a reader and handling its result from the backend), and hands-on evidence of a backend-driven checkout flow in practice.
